global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and a pink-swirled naruto fish cake. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it gleams under warm lighting against a dark wooden table.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections, forming a circular boundary around the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, and slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles, green herbs, and a red spice mound.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice, pinkish-white, tender texture, irregular shape, seasoned with green herbs and black pepper.
regions.menma: The menma bamboo shoots are light brown, fibrous, and irregularly shaped with visible texture and slight curling edges.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale, scalloped-edged, with pink spiral swirl on smooth surface.
